turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Reception, good afternoon. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hi. I'm staying in a standard room until Sunday. My name's Sam.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Yes, I have your booking here. What can I do for you?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: My flight has been changed to Monday morning, so I'd like to stay one more night, on Sunday. Is that possible?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I'm sorry, your room is booked on Sunday night. But our sister hotel is a ten-minute walk away, and it has a room for seventy-five dollars.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thanks, but I'd rather not move to another hotel with all my bags. Is there anything here instead?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: We have a superior room for Sunday night. It's a hundred dollars, so twenty more than your room.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That's okay. Would I need to move my things myself?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: No, housekeeping can move your bags on Sunday morning while you're out.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Perfect. So, the superior room on Sunday night for a hundred dollars, and you'll move my bags.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: That's right. I've added Sunday to your booking. Have a nice day!
